baselines.method: WGS84 ellipsoidal geodesic (Vincenty inverse), km; ECEF chord reported separately

assumptions.file_span_meaning: a file named T is ASSUMED to hold samples in [T - span, T]; a search envelope, not a verified exposure time or a proven upper bound
assumptions.filename_time: last-sample time in previously inspected files (Stage 2)
assumptions.gaps: candidate intervals are unioned only where they overlap or touch; gaps are never covered
assumptions.station_sets: a set's segments are the intersection of its OWN members' segments; co-located siblings never lend coverage
assumptions.s3_last_modified: recorded only; never used as observation time
assumptions.registry: registry presence and archive_verified are configuration, not evidence of data

quality_policies.inventory: incomplete listings flag segments and give exit 3

rule: 2. possible_shared_duration_s descending (union of the set's contiguous segments >= min duration)
4. min_pairwise_baseline_km descending (secondary; NOT a triangulation-quality proxy)

steps: tart-common-gnss for the chosen triad and segment (contemporaneous TLE catalogue)
download and Stage-2 validation only for viable candidates; then Stages 3-7
handoff.warning: never reuse a Stage-1 JSON of another station set; GNSS visibility is not asserted until Stage 1 runs

notes: coverage is FILENAME_CANDIDATE: filename times under a 120 s file-span assumption; no HDF5 sample timestamp was read (verified durations are null)
S3 absence means no archived file, not that a telescope was not observing
--min-baseline-km 500 is a site-diversity cut, not a triangulation-quality metric; geometry is evaluated by Stage 1/4
